data.title: 莉雅丝 · 晨光试衣间的珍珠织带
data.description: 落地窗边的更衣间还有些凉。莉雅丝提起珍珠织带的一端，低头把扭起的白缎裙摆顺好。鱼尾裙在木地板上铺出一道柔和的弧，红发垂到肩前，光线落在布面上。
data.action: 一手拿起珍珠织带，低头理顺婚纱裙摆
data.lighting: 高窗进来的柔光映在白缎褶皱和木地板上
data.promptProse: Rias stands in a tall-windowed fitting room, lifting a pearl ribbon with one hand as she straightens the white satin at her feet. Her off-shoulder mermaid wedding gown fans gently across the floorboards, and a loose strand of long crimson hair falls into the pale morning light.
data.animaCaption: The ribbon hangs from her raised hand while she checks the curve of the satin train below.
